from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd();HARNESS=Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121')
def git(root,*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=root,text=True,timeout=20).strip()
assert git(HARNESS,'rev-parse','HEAD')=='9aa9260920984e2ca05bcb293abb885fccd9c144'
assert not git(HARNESS,'status','--porcelain')
sys.path.insert(0,str(HARNESS/'src'))
source=git(ROOT,'show','HEAD:benchmarks/compiler_cz_identity_prefix.py')
control=types.ModuleType('native_profile_control');control.__file__=str(ROOT/'benchmarks/compiler_cz_identity_prefix.py');exec(compile(source,control.__file__,'exec'),control.__dict__)
report={'implementation_commit':git(ROOT,'rev-parse','HEAD'),'source_commit':git(HARNESS,'rev-parse','HEAD'),'scope':'diagnostic cProfile observations with unchanged independent acceptance; not latency, memory or SDK performance qualification','runner_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'helper_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),'rows':[]}
for case in [(8,'ising','line'),(12,'qft','grid'),(12,'qaoa','sparse')]:
 profiler=cProfile.Profile();profiler.enable();observation=control._observe(case,HARNESS);profiler.disable()
 rows=[]
 for (filename,line,function),(primitive,calls,self_seconds,cumulative,callers) in pstats.Stats(profiler).stats.items():
  if '/flagquantum/' in filename:
   rows.append({'path':str(Path(filename).relative_to(ROOT)) if filename.startswith(str(ROOT)) else filename,'line':line,'function':function,'primitive_calls':primitive,'calls':calls,'self_seconds':self_seconds,'cumulative_seconds':cumulative})
 row={'case':case,'accepted_observation':observation,'top_cumulative':sorted(rows,key=lambda x:x['cumulative_seconds'],reverse=True)[:45],'top_self':sorted(rows,key=lambda x:x['self_seconds'],reverse=True)[:25]};report['rows'].append(row)
 print(case,'accepted; leading self costs:',[(r['function'],r['calls'],round(r['self_seconds'],4)) for r in row['top_self'][:10]],flush=True)
Path('/private/tmp/fq-current-native-profile-20261122.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
